name: Consul Lucien

intro.text: I keep a French house on a British island, which is to say a flag in a garden. It is not a small responsibility. You will excuse me if I treat this as a point of honour.

win: Magnifique! Napoleon himself would have written a very long and very cross letter about that.
after: Longwood is French territory, a small piece of France on St Helena. The wallpaper has been restored to what Napoleon's was. He thought it terrible.
